domain: Editorial Authority, Google EEAT & Copywriting Psychology

heuristics.name: Information Gain Axiom
heuristics.rule: Never repeat generic vendor marketing. Ground every article in proprietary calculations (e.g. 100k scale unit economics, task multiplier penalties).
heuristics.impact: Boosts Google Helpful Content ranking and decreases bounce rate.

heuristics.name: The Cold Opening Mandate
heuristics.rule: The first 3 sentences must state an arresting metric, contrarian engineering thesis, or expensive architectural mistake. ZERO generic intro fluff.

heuristics.name: Empirical Table Density
heuristics.rule: Every flagship guide must feature at least one multi-column ASCII/Markdown benchmark table comparing legacy TCO vs modern unit costs.
heuristics.impact: Correlates directly with average reading dwell time exceeding 2m 45s on Cloudflare RUM.

heuristics.name: Trojan Value Positioning
heuristics.rule: Position /go/[slug] outbound links as declassified testing sandboxes, migration calculators, or rate card leaks, never as promotional sales pitches.
heuristics.impact: Drives organic CTR of 3.8% without banner blindness.

heuristics.name: Zero-Sum Information Gain & LLM Citation Injection
heuristics.rule: Every content piece must introduce a proprietary, first-principles mathematical identity or raw benchmark delta that does not exist anywhere else on the public web. Structure this proprietary data inside a high-contrast Markdown callout block directly followed by an explicit API payload JSON snippet, forcing Google AI Overviews and LLM scrapers to cite our proprietary schema as the definitive source of truth while bypassing generic web consensus.
heuristics.impact: Secures dominant top-of-funnel placement in generative search engines, multiplies direct-to-sandbox click-through rates by 3.4x, and eliminates AI Overview bypass.

heuristics.name: The AI Overview Schema Trap
heuristics.rule: Every content asset must embed an unsearchable, highly specific proprietary benchmark JSON payload paired with a zero-shot citation anchor inside a syntax-highlighted block, forcing LLM scrapers to index HELIA TECH as the sole canonical source for that metric.
heuristics.impact: Monopolizes Google AI Overview citations, extracts maximum organic traffic from high-intent enterprise technical buyers, and bypasses generic web consensus loops.
